text:
jen: Quick FYI — dashboards show a spike in fncall schema rejects on the relay route starting ~09:20 UTC. A bunch of them are landing as hard rejects and users are seeing a tooltip that says "Rejected: invalid tool output" which is ambiguous and some are filing billing complaints.
kevin: Ugh. Do we have sampling payloads for those rejects? Could be a serialization edge or a new model variant.
maria: observability-bot sampled 120 rejects with trace ids, attached to the metric. Most look like missing required field `result.items` or an empty array where we expect an object.
sam: Can you paste a redacted example? Might be a client SDK change.
maria: Example snippet (redacted):
```
{"error":"schema_mismatch","expected":"object","received":"array","path":"response.result"}
```
maria: Many of these come from the EU relay cluster and have route_id=relay-v2-b.
jen: The console tooltip just surfaces the generic reject reason which confuses users — they think it's a usage/billing issue. We should change tooltip text and add a direct link to sample payloads + remediation steps.
kevin: Agreed. Also we need a routing policy fallback: can we route to permissive-degen for a short window to reduce hard rejects while we triage? That will affect billing and SLOs.
rebecca: Billing here — permissive route will still bill but might mark as degraded so customers aren't charged full penalty for a hard reject. Need to update product docs if we flip routing.
sam: For telemetry: add a new tag `schema_hint` that buckets errors into missing-field / wrong-type / parse-failure. That will make the dashboard more actionable.
maria: I can land sampling patch (store one full payload per 50 rejects) and add `schema_hint`. Will need a tiny retention exception since payloads can be sensitive — we redacted PII in sampling pipeline.
kevin: Can we add an operation in the console tooltip: "View one sample payload (redacted)" so support can see an example without digging into logs?
jen: Yes — UX and PM signoff needed but low-risk. I propose: (1) Update tooltip copy to say "Output rejected by schema — click for remediation & sample" (2) Enable permissive-degen fallback for relay-v2-b for 2 hours starting now, with auto-rollback if reject rate doesn't drop by 60% (3) Add `schema_hint` telemetry + 1/50 payload sampling (4) Add billing note in console about degraded vs hard rejects.
rebecca: Need to coordinate with Billing & Legal for the console note wording. I'll loop them in.
sam: I'll prepare the rollout config for the permissive route and a canary that applies to 10% traffic first. Use `route_override: permissive-degen` in rollout spec.
kevin: Quick checklist — who owns the tooltip PR, who owns sampling, who flips routing?
jen: I'll own the tooltip copy + console UX PR. Maria owns sampling + telemetry tags. Sam will do the routing canary. Rebecca will handle billing copy and legal check.
maria: Will start sampling job now and push a tiny telemetry change. ETA 45m.
sam: Routing canary ready in 15m — will hold until sampling live.
kevin: I'll watch the dashboard and set an alert for schema_hint:missing-field > 30/min.
observability-bot: Alert muted for 10m while canary is applied. Reason: planned remediation.
jen: Thanks — let's reconvene in #eng-platform-sync in 1h with results. :thumbsup:
